endRule: Day 1 ends only after Marion reaches a night/sleep resolution.
design: Every block is lived as video beats. Times are windows, not forced cuts. The director advances clock according to actual actions.
invariants: Dominic cannot be contacted before the encounter establishes a plausible contact path.
The first encounter occurs during Day 1, never at game launch.
The exact encounter situation is hidden and selected from eligible variants.
After the encounter, Day 1 continues normally; Dominic does not consume the whole day.
All choices preserve current outfit and prior consequences.
Phone interruptions may happen over ordinary scenes.

phases.director: If Dominic has not yet been encountered, keep ordinary life credible while moving toward one eligible encounter context.

variants: crossing while Marion is moving through the city
phases.contact: Number/contact exchange is conditional, never guaranteed.

beats: Marine conversation can react to what Marion knows
phone only reflects contacts actually obtained
possible second Dominic crossing only if plausible
phases.rule: A second Dominic beat is not guaranteed and must follow schedules/location/contact plausibility.

beats: Dominic follow-up only if causally possible
late conversation/visio only if contact relationship permits

encounterResolver.trigger: Before 15:30, once Marion is outside and at least one plausible encounter context is eligible.
encounterResolver.fallback: If player remains home unusually long, do not teleport Dominic inside. Create a believable reason/opportunity for Marion to leave or shift the encounter later within Day 1.
encounterResolver.replay: Seed changes context/timing/dialogue/camera but not the invariant that the Day-1 encounter happens.

choiceModel.visible: 2-4 natural Marion intentions at a dramatic or practical beat.
choiceModel.hidden: Never show relationship points, encounter probabilities, future spoilers or Dominic's hidden intentions.
choiceModel.freeform: Supported in conversations/calls when runtime can resolve it safely.

videoPlan.branchRule: At a decision beat, freeze narrative progression rather than visibly freezing a face; use a natural hold/cutaway/ambient loop while choice UI appears.
videoPlan.candidatePolicy: Generate multiple candidates when needed; only approved/cached media can enter the player.

day2Handoff.rule: No reset. Start from the exact consequences of Day 1.
possibleDifferences: Dominic number exists or does not
Dominic may have sent/followed up or not
